say:1:1033463001:1.text: I know everything is getting back on track—the residents of the forest, the refugees outside, and our gorgeous Lucent Tree...
say:1:1033463001:1.source_cn: 是的，丛林里的大家，丛林外的难民，还有我们美丽的流荧树...
say:1:1033463001:1.male: I know everything is getting back on track—the residents of the forest, the refugees outside, and our gorgeous Lucent Tree...
say:1:1033463001:1.female: I know everything is getting back on track—the residents of the forest, the refugees outside, and our gorgeous Lucent Tree...

say:2:1033463002:1.text: But I'm still trying to figure out why on earth I made that terrible choice and what the future holds for the Thorned Guards...
say:2:1033463002:1.source_cn: 我还在思考，当时是什么使我做出了错误的选择。荆棘的未来...

say:3:1033463003:1.text: Plants in the same field can grow very differently. What about us?
say:3:1033463003:1.source_cn: 同一片药田的植物长势有好有坏，那么，生活在这里的我们呢？
